retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome group portrait featuring three men in urban attire against a stone pillar, anchored by a stylized interlocking crescent logo in the upper corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring three young men in a high-contrast black and white photograph. They are positioned against a textured stone architectural element. A graphic logo consisting of two interlocking crescent shapes and bold sans-serif lettering sits in the top left corner, utilizing a gold and white color scheme that contrasts with the monochrome image.
coreVisualRelationships: Three subjects arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds
Textured stone pillar acting as a vertical divider and backdrop
Logo placed in the negative space of the upper left corner
High contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights on skin and clothing
coreInvariants: High-contrast monochrome photography for the subjects
Urban architectural background with visible stone texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the foreground, scaled to fill the width of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure leaning against the stone pillar provides the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright logo in the top left, moves down to the first subject, and follows the line of figures to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows on the left and right edges create a frame-within-a-frame effect.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold in the logo graphic
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with zero saturation in the main image; low saturation gold in the graphic.

letterConstructionRules: Rounded outer corners with sharp inner junctions
Letters are tightly tracked and partially overlap the graphic elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' has a short horizontal base
The 'F' has a shortened middle bar
The 'O' is integrated with a crescent stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display mark paired with abstract geometric shapes.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, heavy geometric feel of the 90s era
Provides the necessary geometric circularity for the 'O'

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of three men in 90s urban fashion (leather jackets, t-shirts) leaning against a textured stone pillar in a dark alleyway.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a custom vector logo in the top left corner featuring two interlocking crescent shapes (one gold, one white) with bold, thick geometric sans-serif lettering overlapping them.

verificationChecks: Are there three distinct male subjects?
Is the logo in the top left corner?
Does the logo contain interlocking crescents?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific band names or trademarked logos
Ensure the faces are generic and not recognizable celebrities
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance
Verify the logo is legible against the dark background
Ensure the stone texture is visible
Confirm the three-subject arrangement is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome urban portrait + [Subject Count] + [Architectural Element] + [Geometric Logo Overlay]
